The chart has three components that import `WarningIcon` from `@openmrs/esm-framework` and render it. Each would be affected if the icon's behaviour changed. I found no chart usage of `AllergiesIcon`, which is an alias of `WarningIcon` in core, so it adds no further chart exposure.

**Patient chart usages (most affected first):**

1. **Medications basket item tile**: renders `<WarningIcon size={16} />` next to a warning message (line 91). `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/drug-order-basket-panel/order-basket-item-tile.component.tsx`
2. **Orders basket item tile**: renders `<WarningIcon size={16} />` (line 38). `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/order-basket/general-order-type/order-basket-item-tile.component.tsx`
3. **Lab order basket item tile**: renders `<WarningIcon size={16} />` (line 46). `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-tests-app/src/test-orders/lab-order-basket-panel/lab-order-basket-item-tile.component.tsx`

**Definition and in-core dependents** (these are the source of the change and would propagate to the chart):

- The definition: `WarningIcon = memo(forwardRef(...))` in the styleguide icons module. `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/icons/icons.tsx`
- `AllergiesIcon = WarningIcon` alias in the same file (line 859). Same file as above.
- `DatePickerIcon` renders `WarningIcon` (line 17). `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/datepicker/date-picker-icon.component.tsx`
- Login app location picker empty state renders `WarningIcon` (line 152). `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/location-picker/location-picker-view.component.tsx`

I did not check the chart's test files for assertions against the icon, and the mock files (`mock.tsx`, `mock-jest.tsx`) only stub it, so they are not listed.
